events.body:
## Description

The BLT-Leaf data display test runner may fail on Windows when attempting to start the local Wrangler development server. It currently spawns `npx.cmd` directly, which can result in a `spawn EINVAL` error because Node.js does not reliably spawn Windows command scripts without a shell.

Using a shell to work around this can also complicate termination of the Wrangler process after the tests finish.

### Expected Behavior
The data display test runner should start the local Wrangler server successfully on Windows and clean up the child process when testing is complete.

### Proposed Solution
Use `process.execPath` to invoke Wrangler's JavaScript entry point directly on Windows. Preserve the existing `npx wrangler` behavior on Linux and macOS.

### Verification
The proposed fix was tested on Windows with Node.js v22.11.0:
- Python unit tests: 11 passed
- HTML escape test: passed
- Data display and runtime authentication tests: 94 passed

The tests were run individually because `npm test` could not find the `python3` command in the local Git Bash environment.
